messages:
maya: Quick greenroom check for Thu 11am PT. Need to confirm presenter Zoom accounts, cohosts, reg CTA copy, and whether we enable passback for recordings to GCS. Reg page: https://redwood.ai/events/reframe-2?utm=slack. Also want SRT + auto-transcript ON. Who owns post-event clips? @sophie?

tom: I can own Zoom cohosts + record settings. Will add cohosts: maya, tom, sophie. Can we turn on local recording for presenters too?

sophie: I'll own clip edit + HubSpot tagging. Need raw SRT + MP4. Workflow: 1) Zoom cloud record, 2) RTMP fallback, 3) auto-caption -> export SRT. Want snippet timestamps CSV.

zach: For passback to GCS use service account events-ingest@redwood-prod (will share key with ops). Ops-bot will run transfer job. Note retention policy = 30 days for cloud recordings.

ops-bot: deploy: recording-transfer job scheduled for 2026-03-24T12:05Z -> queued
ops-bot: deploy: recording-transfer job started -> picking files from /zoom/redwood-reframe-2/*
ops-bot: deploy: recording-transfer job success -> uploaded to gs://redwood-events/reframe-2/raw/

maya: Two asks: (1) registration page CTA wording — current: "Join our inference runbook" feels too technical. Options: "See Redwood Inference run the models that power product experiences" OR "Live demo + teardown: runbook for LLM serving". Thoughts? (2) Post-event nurture plan: immediate thank-you + 3-min teaser, 24h edited highlight, full replay + transcript at 48h.

tom: CTA suggestion: "Live demo: production LLM inference at scale" — short & product-forward. Also add reg checkbox: "Share my job title" for segmentation.

sophie: For clip ownership I'll create a Notion task and assign editors. Deliverables: trim intro (0:00-0:20), 2 highlight clips (2–3 min), export SRT and CSV timestamps, push to editors folder. HubSpot property: event_segment=greenroom-demo.

olivia: Request: can I get presenter webcam tracks? Zoom cloud rarely separates. Recommend local recording ON for presenters and have them upload after.

tom: Zoom settings to enable (I'll confirm in account settings):
"record_meeting": true
"recording_storage": "cloud"
"audio_transcription": true
"auto_delete_days": 30

Also enable "alternative host" for cohosts.

zach: Ops note: if auto-delete = 30 days, we should copy final assets to archive-bucket with lifecycle 365 days. Also service-account will need storage.objectAdmin on destination bucket.

sophie: Noted. I'll add HubSpot flow: immediate thank-you email with 3-min clip, 24h highlight, 48h full. Will include survey link in first email.

maya: OK schedule local presenter recording and greenroom dry-run Wed 10:30 PT. Tom — can you DM presenters checklist (local recording, mute other devices, no virtual backgrounds, plug in headphones)? I'll update reg page copy and add survey in thank-you email.

zach: Quick checklist for ops post-event: 1) confirm cloud + local uploads present, 2) ops-bot transfer success, 3) move final assets to archive-bucket, 4) set HS tags + event_segment property, 5) schedule nurture emails.

maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: Greenroom dry-run Wed 10:30 PT. See you then"
